title: A literal scalar whose last line holds only spaces keeps its style when set to text, and the line goes
notes: The new text has no final line break, so the clip header becomes strip (`edit/set-literal-clip-to-strip-no-newline`). The line of spaces was part of the replaced scalar and goes with it; left behind it would be content of the new scalar and change its value (the line holds one character of content after the two-space indentation). The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend left the line of spaces after the new text, which read back as part of the value.
